orangeBarMessage.message: Bring 1 mold back to Dar from the rats in Mileth Crypt

text: Hmm... Perhaps you're not entirely useless. Let's see if you can handle a simple task. Journey to the Mileth Crypt and bring me some mold from the rats that infest that wretched place. Do try not to get yourself killed; it would be such a waste of my time.
